title.zh: Notice on the Closure of Binance Pool Services
title.en: Notice on the Closure of Binance Pool Services

current_state.zh: Binance announced it will discontinue Binance Pool and related services — including Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, Transaction Accelerator, Telegram/email hashrate alerts, and mining pool APIs — on 2026-11-10.
current_state.en: Binance announced it will discontinue Binance Pool and related services — including Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, Transaction Accelerator, Telegram/email hashrate alerts, and mining pool APIs — on 2026-11-10.
